designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Grand Cote National Wildlife Refuge to provide waterfowl habitat under the North American Waterfowl Management Plan.

authority.citation: Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956; Migratory Bird Conservation Act

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Grand Cote National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, 508 Grand Cote National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 168209): "Grand Cote National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1989 under the authority of the Fish and Wildlife Act of 1956"

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Grand Cote National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1989 to provide valuable waterfowl habitat in the Mississippi/Red River floodplain as part of the North American Waterfowl Management Plan.
